Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    try {
      final result = await XbergBridge.ocrBackendSupportsLanguage('nonexistent-backend-xyz', 'eng');
      stdout.writeln(result);
    } catch (error) {
      stderr.writeln('${error.runtimeType}: $error');
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
